offline_source_proof.pinned_arduino_framework: ESP-IDF 4.4.8.240628 framework source in the R7 build closure
offline_source_proof.render_task_affinity: Pinned framework main.cpp creates loopTask using ARDUINO_RUNNING_CORE; exact ESP32 sdkconfig sets CONFIG_ARDUINO_RUNNING_CORE=1; WLED loop calls effect service and BusManager::show on that task. Therefore ESP.getCycleCount() start/end and frame stage counters are read on the same pinned Core 1 task.
offline_source_proof.frequency: Build command uses F_CPU=240000000L. Pinned Arduino initArduino() sets CPU frequency from F_CPU; selected ESP32 sdkconfig has CONFIG_PM_ENABLE unset; source search found no later CPU-frequency or esp_pm_configure call in WLED or the Foundation usermod. Runtime still must read 240 MHz before the baseline, at trace start, and after each window; any mismatch invalidates that window.
offline_source_proof.frame_stage_join: hbnfPerfFrameWorking is initialized at Matrix effect start; every stage counter and kernel/variant value accumulates into that same object until BusManager::show calls hbnfPerfFrameEnd. The trace-relative frameSequence advances once at each frame end while armed and labels those same values. It is a trace-local sequence, not an asserted WLED-native frame number.
offline_source_proof.monotonic_timestamp: esp_timer_get_time() is called only after the raw-cycle threshold test passes. It marks the frame-end capture point, not the beginning of the slow frame.
offline_source_proof.retention_and_loss: Fixed static ring keeps latest 32 outlier records plus a separate maximum frame record. overflowCount increments once for each overwritten ring record and saturates at UINT32_MAX; outlierCount also saturates. Stop/resume preserves ring, counts, worst frame, and sequence; only the initial start clears them.
offline_source_proof.capture_cycle_accounting: traceCaptureBodyCycles measures from just before the rare outlier timestamp/record construction through append, but excludes the final self-accounting field store and critical-section exit. It is explicitly partial. Whole-window trace-disarmed versus trace-armed p99/FPS/max is the measurement of total observer effect.
offline_source_proof.capture_path: No heap allocation, formatting, logging, polling, or added network I/O in hbnfPerfFrameEnd. Normal WLED frame output and the existing Matrix-to-AUX DDP traffic continue; zero network traffic overall is not possible while maintaining identical live rendering conditions. Host does not poll or fetch JSON inside a measurement window.

frozen_policy.p99_diagnostic_rule: A p99 above 42.03125 ms is recorded as regression evidence and does not end the trace. The threshold and all production gates remain unchanged. The separate existing three-consecutive-sample catastrophic limits remain mandatory.

external_sources.fact_used: ESP-IDF says cycle counters are per-core and should be used in a task pinned to one core; esp_timer_get_time has higher overhead; short microbenchmarks can vary with flash-cache behavior.

CONFIG_PM_ENABLE enables PM/DFS support; if disabled, DFS is not active unless the application configures it. The exact build is ESP32 rather than ESP32-S3; ESP32 SDK config independently confirms PM disabled and the source closure sets 240 MHz.

live_authorization: NOT REQUESTED; exact-artifact owner authorization is still required.

telemetry.endpoint_timing: Each GET records monotonic start, monotonic completion, elapsed duration, endpoint identity and status; samples record batch elapsed and sample monotonic time. Failed, pending, or missing endpoints are durably recorded and fail closed.

identity_binding.device_attestation: Adapter verifies exact release/candidate identity from live /hbnf/build.json. SHA is bound by the verified OTA transaction and local/Drive artifact receipt; WLED JSON does not attest binary SHA.

telemetry.frozen_safety: Every sample preserves FPS, p99, max, heap/restarts, Matrix identity, and Matrix-origin AUX native DDP state. The existing 3 consecutive bad-sample rule remains active (FPS <20, p99 >75ms, or AUX projection inactive). No 42.03125ms diagnostic p99 stop.
telemetry.missed_sample: Collector timeout, invalid response, schedule overrun, identity mismatch, AUX failure, or sample gap is a hard invalidation and stops the pair; it is persisted, never skipped.
telemetry.host_invocation_template: HBNF_EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID=hbnf-cart2-r7-outlier-trace-diagnostic-r2-20261009 HBNF_EXPECTED_FIRMWARE_SHA256=9789d9f198699d48f7bf168d7c885d337547724716055e48824072c82c8dfd6b python3 scripts/hbnf_foundation_continuous_soak.py --worker sampler --worker-data <phase-specific JSON: adapter telemetry argv, one kernel-13 inventory entry, durable output directory, duration=60s, initial_delay=4s, include_boundary_sample=true, period=8s, timeout=7s, exact R2 release ID, frozen policy and preflight uptime/restart>
telemetry.schedule_overrun: The existing sampler fails closed and persists the just-returned sample when completion overruns its next 8-second deadline; it does not shift cadence or skip the missed poll.
telemetry.boundary_sample: The existing sampler supports a 4-second initial delay and final boundary sample: reads start at t=4,12,20,28,36,44,52,60. This gives eight 8-second safety samples and an exact 60-second histogram window.

windows.controls: Kernel 13, brightness 44, variant signature 1347100685, tails enabled; same DDP, audio, Vibe, palette, overlay, and runtime controls in both windows. Same 8-second five-endpoint parallel telemetry collector and timeouts in both conditions.
windows.preparation: Take one Packet20 snapshot and keep the recovery snapshot valid. Keep the existing diagnostics mode active. Reset the frame-tail histogram before each condition using the same tails-off/tails-on transition, then apply the same fixed 2-second settle. Confirm kernel, brightness, variant, uptime, 240MHz CPU, and AUX projection via the same read-only collector before timing.
windows.trace_serialization_contamination: Firmware serializes trace record strings only when traceArmed is false AND retainedCount > 0. Before baseline, start then stop once so trace is consumed but empty. Baseline is disarmed with zero records; armed window keeps traceArmed true so record strings are not serialized in any 8-second poll. Do not run a disarmed extension after trace stop. Stop only after armed window; perform final trace readback afterward. If telemetry reports records serialized during either timed window, invalidate as INCONCLUSIVE.
windows.timing: Sample cadence is 8 seconds with an intentional initial 4-second offset; boundary sample at t=60 captures the full histogram. Every request start/end/duration and actual completion time is persisted. Any command timeout, sample gap, or schedule overrun invalidates the pair.
windows.contamination: HTTP reads can create frame spikes. They are not excluded. The identical endpoint set, parallel request schedule, timeouts, and read cadence are used in both conditions. Attribute spikes near request intervals as correlated evidence only, not causal proof. If polling variance or timing overlap prevents attribution, return INCONCLUSIVE.
metrics: per-window sample count and exact sample timestamps
p99, maximum frame time, FPS, and 8-second catastrophic streak
frame-to-stage correlation for all retained trace outliers and the separate worst frame
trace outlier/overflow counts and any retained-record loss
per-endpoint request duration and endpoint status
trace armed state and whether any trace records were serialized during a timed window
CPU MHz and runtime identity on every sample
windows.no_exclusion: Do not discard slow frames, HTTP-correlated frames, overflow indications, failed reads, or invalid samples to improve a comparison. No optional extension; insufficient observations at 60 seconds is INCONCLUSIVE.
windows.duration_realization: Each condition is exactly 60 seconds from monotonic t=0 to t=60. The existing sampler starts at t=4 then polls at t=12,20,28,36,44,52,60; 8 samples total with every inter-sample interval exactly 8 seconds. The final read begins at the window boundary and completes within the same 7-second command budget. Keep trace armed through its completion, record actual endpoint timings, then stop and perform readback.

decision_rules.diagnostic_threshold: R7 p99 >42.03125ms is recorded as regression evidence and does not terminate the diagnostic.
decision_rules.catastrophic_abort: Unchanged frozen policy: 3 consecutive valid 8-second samples with FPS <20, p99 >75ms, or Matrix-origin AUX projection inactive; plus immediate identity, power, restart, health, and rollback safety stops.
decision_rules.observer_effect: Use raw paired distributions and endpoint timings. Do not claim attribution if polling dominates or trace overflow prevents representative stage evidence.
decision_rules.insufficient_or_contaminated: INCONCLUSIVE if regression is not reproduced, sample missing/late, endpoint timing incomplete, trace records serialized asymmetrically, frequency/identity changes, trace overflow prevents useful attribution, or collector/restore fails.
decision_rules.pass_semantics: There is no diagnostic PASS. The outcome is reproduced/localized, reproduced/unlocalized, or INCONCLUSIVE. Production qualification gates remain unchanged.

abort_immediately: Matrix identity/release mismatch, reboot or uptime regression, confirmed power instability, device health loss, or loss of verified rollback readiness.
Existing frozen catastrophic rule: three consecutive valid 8-second samples with FPS below 20, p99 above 75ms, or Matrix-origin AUX projection inactive.
Any missing/late sample, failed endpoint, lost DDP source, CPU-frequency mismatch, asymmetric trace serialization, or unknown renderer restore state.
safety_abort_and_go.live_go_basis: The prior conflict is resolved by the existing parallel 8-second safety collector, run with identical endpoints, cadence, timeouts, and controls in both windows. Trace hot path itself performs no polling, logging, allocation, formatting, or network I/O.
safety_abort_and_go.live_recommendation: GO for one bounded diagnostic transaction after exact-artifact owner authorization and fresh admission/preflight. This is not a production release or R8 and authorizes no install by itself.

execution_recovery.restore_on_every_exit: Stop/pause trace, persist all sampler/trace/error files, and invoke the existing Packet20 snapshot restore in a finally path after success, catastrophic stop, timeout, identity mismatch, collector failure, or user interruption. Verify exact snapshot ID/hash, restoreVerified, lastCommand=restore and lastCommandAccepted=true. Do not restart diagnostic or re-enter after restore.
execution_recovery.end_of_transaction: This diagnostic is not a field release. After the matched pair and verified renderer restoration, return the Matrix to the exact Foundation R4 firmware once and verify release identity/health before leaving it in use.
execution_recovery.owner_authority: Exact-artifact owner authorization is still required before one diagnostic installation and one exact R4 recovery/restoration transaction.
